'''2009 Yavin 4 Regionals Patrick Johnson LS Kessel''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Patrick Johnson]] at [[2009 Yavin 4 Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Name on sheet:''' PMT
* '''Deck name:''' I have No Idea
* '''Username:''' Pat MyT
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
